title: Ephesians Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Ephesians 3: the mystery made known by revelation, the Gentiles as fellow heirs, and a prayer to be strengthened and filled with the fullness of God.

questions.text: How does Paul describe himself in the first verse of this chapter?
questions.explanation: He calls himself the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of the Gentiles he is writing to.

answers.text: The prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of the Gentiles
A teacher sent out by the assembly
A witness to the rulers of this age
A servant of the law of Moses

questions.text: How does Paul say the mystery was made known to him?
questions.explanation: He says that by revelation the mystery was made known to him, as he wrote before in few words.

answers.text: By the elders in Jerusalem
By the prophets of old
By revelation
By careful study of the Scripture

questions.text: To whom does the chapter say the mystery has now been revealed?
questions.explanation: It says the mystery, not made known to the children of men in other generations, has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit.

answers.text: To the rulers of this age
To his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit
To all the children of men alike
To the principalities in the heavenly places

questions.text: What does the chapter say the Gentiles are, according to this mystery?
questions.explanation: It says the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News.

answers.text: Guests in the household for a time
Servants of the saints in Israel
Witnesses of what was promised to others
Fellow heirs and fellow members of the body

questions.text: What was Paul given grace to preach to the Gentiles?
questions.explanation: He says that to him, the very least of all saints, this grace was given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ.

answers.text: The unsearchable riches of Christ
The commandments of the law
The coming judgment of the world
The traditions of the fathers

questions.text: To whom was the manifold wisdom of God to be made known through the assembly?
questions.explanation: It says that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places.

answers.text: To the kings of the earth
To the children of disobedience
To the principalities and the powers
To the saints who had died before

questions.text: What does Paul say he does for this cause, before his prayer?
questions.explanation: He says that for this cause he bows his knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

answers.text: He lifts up his hands in the assembly
He fasts and keeps silent
He sends a letter by a brother
He bows his knees to the Father

questions.text: What does Paul ask that they may be strengthened with, according to the riches of God's glory?
questions.explanation: He asks that God would grant them to be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person.

answers.text: With comfort in all their troubles
With power through his Spirit in the inner person
With wisdom from the apostles
With gifts for the work of service

questions.text: What does Paul pray they may know, so that they may be filled with all the fullness of God?
questions.explanation: He prays that they may know Christ's love, which surpasses knowledge, so that they may be filled with all the fullness of God.

answers.text: Christ's love, which surpasses knowledge
The mystery hidden for ages
The width of the heavenly places
The eternal purpose of God

questions.text: How does the chapter describe the one to whom glory is given at its close?
questions.explanation: It says he is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us.

answers.text: As the one who knows all our thoughts
As the one who judges every family
As the one able to do above all that we ask or think
As the one who dwells in unapproachable light
